dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Well then, is the problem solved?

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Indeed it is! Thank you, Lady Nefer. I'll make sure your fee is paid in the usual manner. I may have further matters that require your assistance in the not-too-distant future...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Lovely. I look forward to another fruitful collaboration.
